content.ascii:
DIAGRAM REVISIONS + PRESENTATION CHOICES

   Retain content         Choose a view        Apply a review
        |                      |                     |
        v                      v                     v
+------------------------------------------------------------+
|                  LIVE CANVAS DOCUMENT                      |
|                                                            |
|  CONTENT BINDING                                            |
|  contentId --------------------> immutable revision R0     |
|                                 ASCII + evidence + refs    |
|                                                            |
|  PLACEMENTS                                                |
|  A: DiagramNode                 B: DiagramNode             |
|  Both refer to the same diagram and bound revision.        |
|       |                              |                     |
|       v                              v                     |
|  A selects an alternative       B keeps its base view       |
|  source: subtree from R1        source: R0                  |
|       |                              |                     |
|       +------------+-----------------+                     |
|                    v                                       |
|  ROW PROJECTION                                            |
|  Compose source rows; retain source revision coordinates.  |
|  Apply folds, syntax, mappings and presentation highlights. |
|                                                            |
|  RESULT: A shows R0 + part of R1; B shows R0.               |
|  Selecting a view issues no content revision.              |
+------------------------------------------------------------+

  Choose / compare                   Review + apply
  Change presentation state.         Merge accepted changes.
  Keep the R0 binding.               Rebind if content changes.

  Canvas checkpoints record the resulting document state.
  Previously issued revision payloads remain immutable.
